heading: INT. CONVERTED SHIPPING CONTAINER - ARBITRATION CHAMBER - DAY

units.text: INT. CONVERTED SHIPPING CONTAINER - ARBITRATION CHAMBER - DAY
A steel box fitted out with pine paneling and ceiling spots.
The corrugated walls ring faintly when anyone walks.
One long table, a flag of the International Chamber, a speaker phone with a blinking red light.
ARBITRATOR BEATRIX ONWUDIWE (60s, white braids pinned up, reading glasses on a chain) sits at the head.
To her left, a STENOGRAPHER, PAOLO DEVEREAUX (30s, headphones, fingers hovering over the machine).
Across the table, claimant's counsel THADDEUS MWANGI (50s, three-piece suit, voice like gravel in velvet) and respondent's counsel SOLVEIG ERIKSEN-BOSE (40s, severe bun, tablet in hand).
At the foot of the table, in the witness chair: CASPIAN LOMBARDI (50s, shipping magnate, signet ring, sweat at the temple).
We are on the record. Mr. Mwangi, proceed.
units.name: ONWUDIWE

units.text: Mr. Lombardi, you owned the vessel Calliope?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: My company did.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: And on the fourteenth of October the Calliope departed Port Said carrying four hundred tonnes of grain?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: That is correct.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Who authorized the departure?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: The master. Captain Oyelaran.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Not you?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: I do not authorize individual departures.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Eriksen-Bose lifts her eyes from her tablet.
Objection. Relevance.
units.name: ERIKSEN-BOSE

units.text: Overruled. Continue.
units.name: ONWUDIWE

units.text: Were you aware the hull had failed inspection?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: I was informed of minor deficiencies.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Minor. Mr. Lombardi, I have a report here that uses the word "catastrophic" nine times.
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: Reports exaggerate.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: The speaker phone crackles.
A woman's voice, slightly delayed, slightly electronic.
Apologies, Madam Arbitrator, this is the interpreter from Alexandria. Is the witness's last answer on the record in English?
units.name: KALINDA

units.text: It is, Ms. Kalinda. He spoke English.
units.name: ONWUDIWE

units.text: Understood. Please proceed.
units.name: KALINDA

units.text: Mwangi paces the length of the container, boots ringing on the steel floor.
Did you or did you not instruct the master to leave regardless of the inspection?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: I did not.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Then why does this email, dated the thirteenth, say, quote, "Sail or we lose the contract"?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: Eriksen-Bose rises.
Madam Arbitrator, that email has not been authenticated.
units.name: ERIKSEN-BOSE

units.text: Mr. Mwangi?
units.name: ONWUDIWE

units.text: I will authenticate it through the next witness.
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: Then I will not admit it now.
units.name: ONWUDIWE

units.text: Caspian relaxes by half an inch.
Mwangi turns, unhurried, back to the table.
Mr. Lombardi, let us talk about the insurance.
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: Caspian's hand goes to his tie.
Loosens it.
What about it?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: It was raised on the twelfth. By forty percent.
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: Standard practice.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: On a vessel you believed to be sound?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: Prudence.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Or foresight.
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: Objection. Argumentative.
units.name: ERIKSEN-BOSE

units.text: Sustained.
units.name: ONWUDIWE

units.text: Paolo's keys clack on.
Caspian takes a handkerchief from his pocket and dabs his forehead, folds it, folds it again.
Madam, forgive me, there is a power flicker on our end. We may drop.
units.name: KALINDA

units.text: Noted. Mr. Lombardi, please answer the question.
units.name: ONWUDIWE

units.text: What question?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Did you foresee the loss of the ship?
units.name: MWANGI

units.text: The container is silent.
A fan turns above.
The speaker phone hisses.
Eriksen-Bose's pen taps once on the table, a signal.
I would like to consult with counsel.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Granted. Ten minutes.
units.name: ONWUDIWE

units.text: He stands.
His chair scrapes.
As he crosses, his shoulder knocks the speaker phone, and the red light goes dark.
...hello? Madam? Hello?
units.name: KALINDA

units.text: The line dies.
